Name: Multi-Floor Greenhouse
Author: N3rdGirl64
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/yUnMzZI.png[/img]
[size=4]Tired of the small size of the greenhouse? Yeah so was I. This new greenhouse adds multiple floors to allow for more crops, more tree planting spots, and even some processing space if you so wish!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HG54Q4A.png[/img]
Make sure you have the latest version [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20139]HxW Tilesheets[/url] installed as well as the latest version of SMAPI. Then just make sure you unzip the file and place it in your mods folder.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/AuzWiMM.png[/img]
Any and all mods that change the greenhouse will not work or play nicely with this mod.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jHFywsk.png[/img]
Any issues should be reported in the Bugs Section of this page and should have SMAPI logs added too.[/size][/center]
